findings: Date filter scope not shown on the page (confirmed, minor): population, sector and purok cards ignore date_from/date_to but the range line implies everything is bounded. Add a note that dates apply to appointments and revenue only.

Expired session during fetch (likely, minor): fetch follows the 302 to login, response.json() throws, and the user sees a parse error. Treat response.redirected or non-JSON content as 'session expired, sign in again'.
Summary endpoint recomputes every block (confirmed, minor): page load computes each block twice (summary plus the dedicated endpoint). Acceptable at barangay scale; revisit if data grows.

Production static storage unchanged (confirmed, pre-existing): STATICFILES_STORAGE is ignored by Django 5.2, so production serves unhashed files. Fix with STORAGES in a separate change; already on the final-report list.
